mentions.name: Alternative mental health offerings exploration
mentions.description: A website exploring what an alternative to current mental health offerings might look like, questioning what therapy would be like without an economic container and how to provide a forum for changing people's environments rather than only helping individuals cope with or decrease their dysphoria.
mentions.problem: Current mental health offerings focus on making individuals cope with or decrease their dysphoria instead of also providing a way to change the environment that contributes to bad mental health.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to put my finger on what an alternative to current mental health offerings might look like (entirelyundefined.com). What would therapy be like without the economic container?
